name: security-409
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its photograph is taken from the paved court south of the building, under a tree, looking north-north-west at the chamfered south corner of its upper storey: the south-west end (left), the chamfer (facing the camera) and the south-east face (right), over a glazed ground storey set back on a raised deck; level, its optical axis at bearing 348.9 degrees and 0.9 degrees down. Its camera is fitted to both faces' roof edges against the sky and the leaves (51.5 m, the parapet's top in the LiDAR's returns along the faces, which run 1.8 degrees off the frame's axis) and to seven upright edges (the chamfer's joints, a column, a post and a panel), held near 1.6 m over the LiDAR's ground: rms 0.76 px over 26 residuals, 1.6 m over the ground about 10.5 m south of the corner. Its lens of 71.4 degrees across agrees with the camera's own record (a 24 mm equivalent, 71.6 degrees across this frame). Through it the chamfer's top corners, which the fit does not use, fall on the two faces' lines within 0.01 m, and make the chamfer 3.4 m wide at 42 degrees; the LiDAR's returns at the parapet's height there lie on that line, and the corner's returns beyond it are the tree's.

building.title: Security (409), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 409's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 409 by its id.

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above 2.99 m over the provisional ground (43.45 m, the median LiDAR ground within the outline's band, as the measured massing took it); the centre from the same points (tower_above), which lie within 1.5 m of the campus map ring. The walls' axis runs along the long faces (bearing 42.0 deg), so z faces north-west (bearing 312.0 deg), toward the road along that side. The ground falls from about 46.5 m on the north-east to 39 m south-west of the building
